name: codex-cr-loop
description: Codex review loop commands: iterate /codex:review until two consecutive clean rounds, with three completion modes (review-only stop, local merge, push + open PR). Always-on interaction-logic guard blocks user-visible UX changes (gestures, dialog/menu types, shortcuts, navigation) until the user explicitly confirms. Final report always ends with a Chinese business-impact summary module: a 3–8 line summary when commits change user-observable behavior, or a single literal line `无业务逻辑影响` for pure refactors. Preflight base-currency gate (v1.5.0) hard-stops the loop (rebase-first / abort) when the feature branch isn't built on top of its base; the base branch is auto-detected (main / master / any default).
